scope: Exploratory AI-reviewed screening, not human-validated accuracy
decision_policy: Pass only if all gates are met. Insufficient denominators are inconclusive, not pass. A pass supports exploratory scoring only. Failure requires a new development revision and new validation sample, not patching this held-out set. No full 6000-image launch is automatic.
review_policy: AI review before reading model predictions, no expected answers or generation conditions supplied. Preserve uncertainty and identity ambiguity; do not force labels. Existing thread context prevents claiming fully independent blind human validation. Freeze review labels before joining predictions.
analysis_policy: Report all 40 images per semantic, missing/ambiguous/unclear/error counts, raw answer agreement separately from binary success, and false-success/false-failure rates with denominators. DINO counts require exact-count agreement and MAE on numerically clear reference labels. Do not convert model errors to zero. Break down texture into pattern/surface and spatial into 2D/depth/containment. Subtypes with fewer than 10 clear images are descriptive/inconclusive. Report per-prompt agreement; do not treat four correlated images as independent replications. No inferential accuracy claim from this small AI-reviewed sample.
threshold_rationale: Conservative operational screening targets chosen after development review and before held-out outputs, not literature-certified thresholds. Intended to avoid accepting a noisy evaluator on raw aggregate agreement. Known development failures may persist; this is a locked generalization check, not a declaration of development success.
